status: prospective independent-stability validation design; no external predictor evaluated when written
eligibility: Unique exact observed ref/mut sequence mapping, finite positive paired half-lives, no p-value filter; exclude localization development genes, exact sequence containment and at least 90 percent global sequence identity
features: Counts per 100 nt for every 1-, 2-, 3-, 4-mer; mutant minus reference. HGB additionally receives symmetric mean mono/dinucleotide composition. No localization outcome features.
pair_orientation: Augment training with reverse pairs inside the same biological group; report antisymmetrized predictions, giving zero for identical sequences and opposite signs on reversal
splits: 5 outer and 3 inner GroupKFold partitions by connected gene and ref/mut sequence identity of at least 95 percent; each cell independently; all transformations train-only
selection: minimum inner gene-macro squared error; ties within 1e-10 select model order ridge_10, ridge_100, hgb_7
weights: equal biological groups, then equal paired variants; orientations each get half the variant weight

bootstrap.unit: connected biological group; keep both alleles together

failed_admission: Retain all results, exclude the predictor from primary localization features; no threshold relaxation or further architecture search
scope: External stability validation only; never opens Astrocyte, N-zip or quarantined TDP stability data
